c1-tarsadalmireteg-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Water Head
c1-tarsadalmireteg-01.scenario: In a class on regional inequality you explain the image of the 'water head'.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-01.prompt: Explain what the image of the 'water head' says about Budapest.
cues: Mention the capital and the countryside
c1-tarsadalmireteg-01.target: A 'vízfej' képe azt állítja, hogy a főváros súlya aránytalanul nagy a vidékhez képest.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-01.english: The image of the 'water head' claims that the capital's weight is out of proportion to the countryside.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-01.canDo: I can describe how strongly Budapest dominates Hungary's economy and population.

c1-tarsadalmireteg-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Wherever the Railway Ends
c1-tarsadalmireteg-02.scenario: In a class on rural transport you describe what happens when a branch line closes.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-02.prompt: Say what happens wherever a branch line closes.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-02.target: Bárhol megszűnik a vasút, ott nehezebb eljutni a munkahelyre.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-02.english: Wherever the railway ends, it is harder to get to work.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-02.canDo: I can describe transport poverty and branch-line closures in rural Hungary.

c1-tarsadalmireteg-03.title: Communicative Challenge: City and Village
c1-tarsadalmireteg-03.scenario: In a class on public services you compare a city and a small village.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-03.prompt: Compare the number of doctors in a town and a village.
cues: Name the town and the village
c1-tarsadalmireteg-03.target: Míg a városban több az orvos, addig a faluban kevesebb.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-03.english: While there are more doctors in the town, there are fewer in the village.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-03.canDo: I can describe differences in health care and school provision between a city and a small village.

c1-tarsadalmireteg-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Village Farm
c1-tarsadalmireteg-04.scenario: In a class on rural development you explain why a village started to farm.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-04.prompt: Say why a village started a community farm.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-04.target: A falu a helyi önellátás megteremtése érdekében közösségi gazdaságot indított.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-04.english: In order to create local self-sufficiency, the village started a community farm.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-04.canDo: I can describe how some villages try to keep their population with local projects.

c1-tarsadalmireteg-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Judgement?
c1-tarsadalmireteg-05.scenario: In a class on regional policy you report an expert's view on decentralisation.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-05.prompt: Report what some experts say about decentralisation.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-05.target: Egyes szakértők szerint a decentralizáció vitathatatlanul segíti a fejlődést.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-05.english: According to some experts decentralisation undeniably helps development.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-05.canDo: I can describe what decentralisation and a balanced spatial structure mean.

c1-tarsadalmireteg-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Centre and Periphery Review
c1-tarsadalmireteg-consolidation.scenario: In a final class on regional inequality you summarise two points.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-consolidation.prompt: Summarise one difference between city and village and one aim.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-consolidation.target: Míg a városban több az orvos, addig a faluban kevesebb. A falu megtartása érdekében helyi munkahelyek kellenek.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-consolidation.english: While there are more doctors in the town, there are fewer in the village. To keep the village population, local jobs are needed.
c1-tarsadalmireteg-consolidation.canDo: I can describe Budapest's weight, transport poverty and the shortage of doctors and teachers in villages.

c1-kiberbiztonsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Firewall Is Not Fire
c1-kiberbiztonsag-01.scenario: In a class on cyber security you explain a war or medicine image used in the field.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-01.prompt: Explain in plain words what a firewall or ransomware is.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-01.target: A tűzfal nem tűz ellen véd, hanem illetéktelen behatolók ellen a hálózatban.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-01.english: A firewall does not protect against fire but against unauthorised intruders in the network.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-01.canDo: I can describe a hypothetical cyber attack on critical infrastructure such as a power grid or a hospital.

c1-kiberbiztonsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Court Demanded
c1-kiberbiztonsag-02.scenario: In a class on surveillance law you report what a court has said about secret surveillance.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-02.prompt: Say what a court or a rights group requires for secret surveillance.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-02.target: Az emberi jogi szervezetek szerint a titkos megfigyeléshez független bírói kontroll kell.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-02.english: According to human rights organisations, secret surveillance needs independent judicial control.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-02.canDo: I can describe the Pegasus affair, zero-day vulnerabilities and lawful interception.

c1-kiberbiztonsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Behind the Attack
c1-kiberbiztonsag-03.scenario: In a class on threat analysis you present a careful claim about who was behind an attack.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-03.prompt: Say who was probably behind an attack, without claiming certainty.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-03.target: A technikai bizonyítékok minden valószínűség szerint egy külföldi csoportra utalnak.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-03.english: The technical evidence points in all likelihood to a foreign group.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-03.canDo: I can describe what the NIS2 Directive and a national incident response team do.

c1-kiberbiztonsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: More Data, More Risk
c1-kiberbiztonsag-04.scenario: In a class on data protection you link the amount of collected data to the risk.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-04.prompt: Say how the amount of collected data relates to the risk of abuse.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-04.target: Minél több adatot gyűjtenek, annál nagyobb a visszaélés veszélye.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-04.english: The more data is collected, the greater the risk of abuse.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-04.canDo: I can describe surveillance capitalism and what the GDPR requires of those who collect data.

c1-kiberbiztonsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Condition and an Exception
c1-kiberbiztonsag-05.scenario: In a class on resilience you explain when a hospital can keep working during a cyber attack.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-05.prompt: Say when a hospital can keep working and when it cannot.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-05.target: A kórház tovább tud működni, feltéve, hogy működik a tartalék rendszer, kivéve, ha a támadás a tartalékot is eléri.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-05.english: The hospital can keep working, provided that the backup system works, except if the attack reaches the backup too.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-05.canDo: I can describe what societal resilience and quantum-safe communication mean.

c1-kiberbiztonsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Cyber Security Review
c1-kiberbiztonsag-consolidation.scenario: In a final class on cyber security you summarise two points.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-consolidation.prompt: Summarise one risk and one rule.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-consolidation.target: A zsarolóvírus veszélyt jelent a kórházakra, ezért a törvény auditkötelezettséget ír elő.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-consolidation.english: Ransomware is a danger to hospitals, so the law prescribes an audit duty.
c1-kiberbiztonsag-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a hypothetical cyber attack and explain war and medicine images in cyber security.

c1-munkaeropiac-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Guest Workers and the Labour Shortage
c1-munkaeropiac-01.scenario: At a seminar on the labour market in Hungary you are asked about the guest workers who live in the workers' hostels near Tiszaújváros and Iváncsa.
c1-munkaeropiac-01.prompt: Say why employers refer to guest workers and what the critics fear, and set the two views against each other with 'míg egyfelől … addig másfelől'.
cues: Mention what the employers refer to
Mention what the trade unions fear for wages
c1-munkaeropiac-01.target: Míg egyfelől a munkáltatók a betöltetlen állásokra hivatkoznak, addig másfelől a szakszervezetek a hazai bérek alakulásától tartanak.
c1-munkaeropiac-01.english: While on the one hand the employers refer to the vacancies, on the other hand the trade unions fear for how domestic wages develop.
c1-munkaeropiac-01.canDo: I can explain why employers hire guest workers in Hungarian factories and what critics say about wages (*vendégmunkás, munkásszálló, munkaerőhiány*).

c1-munkaeropiac-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Stages of a Change in a Factory
c1-munkaeropiac-02.scenario: At the same seminar you describe how work in a factory can change step by step.
c1-munkaeropiac-02.prompt: Describe three stages of a change in a factory's work with 'kezdetben', 'ezt követően' and 'végül'.
cues: Say what happened in the end
c1-munkaeropiac-02.target: Kezdetben csak egy műszakban dolgoztak, ezt követően bevezették a háromműszakos munkarendet, végül pedig új dolgozókat vettek fel.
c1-munkaeropiac-02.english: At first they worked in only one shift, after this the three-shift schedule was introduced, and in the end new workers were hired.
c1-munkaeropiac-02.canDo: I can describe how assembly-line work is organised (*futószalag-munka, normaemelés, háromműszakos munkarend*).

c1-munkaeropiac-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Platform Work and the KATA Change
c1-munkaeropiac-03.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about delivery couriers in Budapest and the KATA change of 2022.
c1-munkaeropiac-03.prompt: Say what happened to the KATA in 2022 and what the European Union did in 2024, and give its purpose with 'céljából'.
cues: Mention the year of the KATA change
Mention the EU directive and its year
Give the purpose of the directive
c1-munkaeropiac-03.target: 2022 júliusában a parlament egy nap alatt elfogadta a KATA változtatásait. A platformmunkások védelme céljából az Európai Unió 2024-ben irányelvet fogadott el.
c1-munkaeropiac-03.english: In July 2022 parliament adopted the changes to the KATA within one day. For the purpose of protecting platform workers the European Union adopted a directive in 2024.
c1-munkaeropiac-03.canDo: I can describe platform work and the KATA change of 2022, with the year and who said what (*platformkapitalizmus, futár, KATA-adózás*).

c1-munkaeropiac-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dispute over Strike Rules
c1-munkaeropiac-04.scenario: At the seminar you report the dispute about the strike rules for teachers in 2022.
c1-munkaeropiac-04.prompt: Report what the unions and the government said about the strike rules, and say what some analysts expect, with 'minden valószínűség szerint'.
cues: Give the year of the decree
Give an analysts' forecast and say whose it is
c1-munkaeropiac-04.target: 2022-ben a kormány rendeletben írta elő a 'még elégséges szolgáltatást'. A szakszervezetek szerint ez kiüresítette a sztrájkjogot, egyes elemzők szerint pedig minden valószínűség szerint nő a pályaelhagyók száma.
c1-munkaeropiac-04.english: In 2022 the government laid down 'sufficient service' by decree. According to the unions this emptied the right to strike, and according to some analysts the number of people leaving the profession will in all probability grow.
c1-munkaeropiac-04.canDo: I can describe the dispute over strike rules for teachers in 2022, naming each side's view (*sztrájkjog, vadsztrájk, polgári engedetlenség*).

c1-munkaeropiac-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Commuting to Austria
c1-munkaeropiac-05.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the people from Sopron and Szombathely who work in Austria.
c1-munkaeropiac-05.prompt: Say why many people commute to Austria and give an analysts' conclusion with 'a fentiek tükrében'.
cues: Give a conclusion and say whose view it is
c1-munkaeropiac-05.target: Sokan ingáznak naponta Ausztriába, mert ott több munkakörben magasabb fizetést remélnek. A fentiek tükrében egyes elemzők a tudásalapú gazdaság erősítését tartják fontosnak.
c1-munkaeropiac-05.english: Many people commute to Austria every day because they hope for higher pay there in many jobs. In the light of the above some analysts consider strengthening the knowledge-based economy important.
c1-munkaeropiac-05.canDo: I can describe commuting from western Hungary to Austria and the debate about wages (*határ menti ingázás, agyelszívás, bérfelzárkózás*).

c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Labour-Market Debate in Summary
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.scenario: You close the seminar on the Hungarian labour market by summing up the debate.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the debate about guest workers and wages in two views, and end with a short conclusion.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.target: Míg egyfelől a munkáltatók munkaerőhiányra hivatkoznak, addig másfelől a szakszervezetek a bérek alakulásától tartanak. A fentiek tükrében a vita még folytatódik.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.english: While on the one hand the employers refer to a labour shortage, on the other hand the trade unions fear for how wages develop. In the light of the above the debate continues.
c1-munkaeropiac-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the labour-market debate about guest workers, naming whose view each is.

c1-mestersegesnyelv-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Language Models and Hungarian
c1-mestersegesnyelv-01.scenario: At a seminar on language and artificial intelligence you are asked why some linguists see the English texts in language models as a risk for Hungarian.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-01.prompt: Say what some linguists fear and say that it is their view, using 'veszélyt jelent'.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-01.target: Egyes nyelvészek szerint a nyelvmodellek angol túlsúlya veszélyt jelent a magyar nyelv sokszínűségére.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-01.english: According to some linguists the English dominance of language models poses a danger to the diversity of the Hungarian language.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-01.canDo: I can explain why some linguists see the English dominance in language models as a risk for Hungarian (*nagy nyelvmodell, tanítóadat, gépi fordítás*).

c1-mestersegesnyelv-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Voice Assistants and Hungarian
c1-mestersegesnyelv-02.scenario: At the same seminar you are asked about voice-controlled devices in a Hungarian living room.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-02.prompt: Say what linguists demand for devices and say whose demand it is, using 'elengedhetetlen' or 'kötelessége'.
cues: Say what the state should ensure
c1-mestersegesnyelv-02.target: Egyes nyelvészek szerint az államnak kötelessége biztosítani a magyar nyelv jelenlétét a digitális eszközökben.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-02.english: According to some linguists the state has a duty to ensure the presence of the Hungarian language in digital devices.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-02.canDo: I can describe why voice assistants matter for the use of Hungarian (*hangvezérlés, digitális kirekesztődés*).

c1-mestersegesnyelv-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The PULI Language Model
c1-mestersegesnyelv-03.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the language model that researchers of the Research Centre for Linguistics developed.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-03.prompt: Say who developed the PULI model and what the developers expect from more texts, using 'minél … annál …'.
cues: Name the model and its developers
Link the amount of text to the quality
c1-mestersegesnyelv-03.target: A Nyelvtudományi Kutatóközpont kutatói fejlesztették a PULI modellt. A fejlesztők szerint minél több magyar szöveggel tanítják, annál pontosabb lehet.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-03.english: Researchers of the Research Centre for Linguistics developed the PULI model. According to the developers the more Hungarian text it is trained with, the more accurate it can be.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-03.canDo: I can describe the PULI language model and who developed it (*PULI modell, Nyelvtudományi Kutatóközpont, korpuszépítés*).

c1-mestersegesnyelv-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Deepfakes and Copyright
c1-mestersegesnyelv-04.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about deepfakes and the use of authors' texts for training.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-04.prompt: Report a researchers' forecast about deepfakes with a hedge and say whose view it is.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-04.target: A kutatók szerint a hangklónozás feltehetőleg egyre meggyőzőbb lesz, a jogászok szerint pedig a szerzői jogi kérdések minden bizonnyal vita tárgyai maradnak.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-04.english: According to researchers voice cloning will presumably become more and more convincing, and according to lawyers the copyright questions will in all probability remain a subject of debate.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-04.canDo: I can describe the questions that deepfakes and data scraping raise (*mélyhamisítás, adatkaparás, szerzői jogi oltalom*).

c1-mestersegesnyelv-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Future of Hungarian
c1-mestersegesnyelv-05.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up what was said about the future of Hungarian.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-05.prompt: Sum up the debate with 'mindent egybevetve' and say whose view the conclusion is.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-05.target: Mindent egybevetve, egyes nyelvészek szerint a magyar nyelv jövője a nyelvtechnológiai fejlesztéseken és a mindennapi nyelvhasználaton is múlik.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-05.english: All things considered, according to some linguists the future of the Hungarian language also depends on language-technology developments and everyday language use.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-05.canDo: I can describe the debate on the future of Hungarian in the age of language models (*digitális humanizmus, nyelvi ökológia*).

c1-mestersegesnyelv-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Language and Artificial Intelligence in Summary
c1-mestersegesnyelv-consolidation.scenario: You close the seminar by summing up the views on Hungarian and language models.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-consolidation.prompt: Name one risk and one expectation, say whose they are, and end with a conclusion.
cues: Name a risk and whose view it is
Name an expectation and whose view it is
c1-mestersegesnyelv-consolidation.target: Egyes nyelvészek szerint a nyelvmodellek angol túlsúlya veszélyt jelent. A fejlesztők szerint minél több magyar szöveggel tanítják őket, annál pontosabbak lehetnek. A fentiek tükrében a vita folytatódik.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-consolidation.english: According to some linguists the English dominance of language models poses a danger. According to the developers the more Hungarian text they are trained with, the more accurate they can be. In the light of the above the debate continues.
c1-mestersegesnyelv-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the risks and chances that people see in language models for Hungarian, naming whose view each is.

c1-felsooktatas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Model Change
c1-felsooktatas-01.scenario: At a seminar on Hungarian higher education you are asked about the model change of 2019-2021.
c1-felsooktatas-01.prompt: Name a criticism and the government's position, and say whose they are.
cues: Give the government's position at the time
c1-felsooktatas-01.target: A bírálók szerint a kuratóriumok összetétele korlátozza az egyetemi autonómiát. A kormány akkori álláspontja szerint az alapítványi forma rugalmasabb működést tesz lehetővé.
c1-felsooktatas-01.english: According to the critics the composition of the boards restricts university autonomy. According to the government's position at the time the foundation form allows more flexible operation.
c1-felsooktatas-01.canDo: I can describe the 2019-2021 model change of Hungarian universities and what its critics and the government said (*modellváltás, közérdekű vagyonkezelő alapítvány, kuratórium*).

c1-felsooktatas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe
c1-felsooktatas-02.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the decision of the EU Council in December 2022.
c1-felsooktatas-02.prompt: Say what the Council decided and report a lawyers' demand, naming whose it is.
c1-felsooktatas-02.target: 2022 decemberében az Európai Unió Tanácsa úgy döntött, hogy az alapítványi egyetemekkel nem vállalhatók új jogi kötelezettségek. Egyes jogászok szerint elengedhetetlen volna szigorítani az összeférhetetlenségi szabályokat.
c1-felsooktatas-02.english: In December 2022 the Council of the European Union decided that no new legal commitments can be made with the foundation universities. According to some lawyers it would be indispensable to tighten the conflict-of-interest rules.
c1-felsooktatas-02.canDo: I can describe the December 2022 decision on Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe and its background (*Erasmus-program, Horizont Európa, összeférhetetlenségi szabály*).

c1-felsooktatas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The SZFE Blockade
c1-felsooktatas-03.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the blockade of the University of Theatre and Film Arts in 2020.
c1-felsooktatas-03.prompt: Say how long the blockade lasted and what the students said, with 'minél … annál …'.
cues: Give the year and the length
Say whose view the 'minél … annál …' sentence is
c1-felsooktatas-03.target: 2020 őszén a hallgatók 71 napig tartó blokádot tartottak. A hallgatók szerint minél tovább tartott, annál több támogatót szerzett az ügyük.
c1-felsooktatas-03.english: In autumn 2020 the students held a blockade lasting 71 days. According to the students the longer it lasted, the more supporters their cause won.
c1-felsooktatas-03.canDo: I can describe the SZFE blockade of 2020 (*SZFE-blokád, egyetemfoglalás, diákszolidaritás*).

c1-felsooktatas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Nobel Prizes of 2023
c1-felsooktatas-04.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the two Nobel Prizes of October 2023.
c1-felsooktatas-04.prompt: Name the two laureates and report a hedged view about research careers, with its source.
cues: Name the two prizes and the month
Hedge the view and say whose it is
c1-felsooktatas-04.target: 2023 októberében Karikó Katalin orvosi, Krausz Ferenc pedig fizikai Nobel-díjat kapott. Az elemzők szerint a kutatói pályák vonzereje minden bizonnyal a finanszírozástól is függ.
c1-felsooktatas-04.english: In October 2023 Karikó Katalin received the Nobel Prize in medicine and Krausz Ferenc the one in physics. According to analysts the attractiveness of research careers in all probability also depends on funding.
c1-felsooktatas-04.canDo: I can describe the Nobel Prizes of Karikó Katalin and Krausz Ferenc in 2023 with the years (*mRNS technológia, attoszekundumos fizika*).

c1-felsooktatas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: University Autonomy
c1-felsooktatas-05.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the debate on university autonomy.
c1-felsooktatas-05.prompt: Sum up the debate with 'mindent egybevetve' and say what the sides disagree about.
cues: Say what the debate is about
c1-felsooktatas-05.target: Mindent egybevetve, a vita arról szól, mekkora önállóságot kapjanak az egyetemek. A felek álláspontja ebben eltér.
c1-felsooktatas-05.english: All things considered, the debate is about how much independence the universities should have. The positions of the sides differ on this.
c1-felsooktatas-05.canDo: I can describe the debate on university autonomy and scientific sovereignty (*tudományos szuverenitás, egyetemi önrendelkezés*).

c1-felsooktatas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Universities in Summary
c1-felsooktatas-consolidation.scenario: You close the seminar by summing up the model change, the EU decision and the blockade.
c1-felsooktatas-consolidation.prompt: Name one criticism, one year and a conclusion.
cues: Name a criticism and whose it is
c1-felsooktatas-consolidation.target: A bírálók szerint a kuratóriumok összetétele korlátozza az egyetemi autonómiát. 2022 decemberében az Európai Unió Tanácsa döntött az Erasmus+ forrásokról. A fentiek tükrében a vita folytatódik.
c1-felsooktatas-consolidation.english: According to the critics the composition of the boards restricts university autonomy. In December 2022 the Council of the European Union decided on the Erasmus+ funds. In the light of the above the debate continues.
c1-felsooktatas-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the model change, the Erasmus+ decision and the SZFE blockade, naming whose view each is.

c1-varosfejlesztes-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Commuting Around Budapest
c1-varosfejlesztes-01.scenario: At a seminar on city development you are asked about the people who commute from Érd and Budaörs to Budapest.
c1-varosfejlesztes-01.prompt: Name a problem of commuting and say whose view it is, using 'terhelést jelent'.
c1-varosfejlesztes-01.target: Egyes városkutatók szerint a gyors kiköltözés terhelést jelent az agglomerációs települések iskoláira és orvosi rendelőire.
c1-varosfejlesztes-01.english: According to some urban researchers rapid out-migration is a burden on the schools and doctors' surgeries of the agglomeration towns.
c1-varosfejlesztes-01.canDo: I can describe commuting and suburban growth around Budapest and what people say about it (*agglomeráció, alvóváros, autófüggőség*).

c1-varosfejlesztes-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Former Industrial Areas
c1-varosfejlesztes-02.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the former factory areas of Csepel.
c1-varosfejlesztes-02.prompt: Report a planning demand and say whose demand it is, using 'kellene'.
cues: Say what the local government should set
c1-varosfejlesztes-02.target: Egyes civil szervezetek és építészek szerint szigorú beépítési korlátokat kellene szabni, és megfizethető bérlakások építését kellene megkövetelni.
c1-varosfejlesztes-02.english: According to some civil organisations and architects strict building limits should be set and the building of affordable rented flats should be required.
c1-varosfejlesztes-02.canDo: I can describe the redevelopment of former industrial areas and the debate about it (*rozsdaövezet, dzsentrifikáció, beépítési mutató*).

c1-varosfejlesztes-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cycle Lanes and the HÉV
c1-varosfejlesztes-03.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the cycle lanes of the Nagykörút and the suburban railway.
c1-varosfejlesztes-03.prompt: Say what transport researchers think about the HÉV, with 'minél … annál …'.
cues: Link the delay to the car use
c1-varosfejlesztes-03.target: A közlekedéskutatók szerint minél tovább halogatják a HÉV korszerűsítését, annál inkább az autóhasználatra ösztönözhetik az elővárosok lakosságát.
c1-varosfejlesztes-03.english: According to transport researchers the longer the modernisation of the HÉV is put off, the more they may push the population of the suburbs towards using the car.
c1-varosfejlesztes-03.canDo: I can describe the dispute about cycle lanes and suburban railways in Budapest (*kerékpáros infrastruktúra, HÉV, forgalomcsillapítás*).

c1-varosfejlesztes-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The City Park Dispute
c1-varosfejlesztes-04.scenario: At the seminar you are asked about the dispute over the City Park.
c1-varosfejlesztes-04.prompt: Say what the climate models expect and why the critics wanted to keep the trees, with a hedge.
c1-varosfejlesztes-04.target: A klímamodellek szerint a belvárosi hősziget-hatás várhatóan erősödik. A Városliget-vita bírálói ezért a fák megóvását tartották fontosnak.
c1-varosfejlesztes-04.english: According to climate models the urban heat island effect in the inner city is expected to grow stronger. The critics in the City Park dispute therefore considered it important to protect the trees.
c1-varosfejlesztes-04.canDo: I can describe the dispute about the City Park, with the years (*zöldfelület-védelem, Városliget-vita, hősziget-hatás*).

c1-varosfejlesztes-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The 15-Minute City
c1-varosfejlesztes-05.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the debate on the 15-minute city.
c1-varosfejlesztes-05.prompt: Sum up the debate with 'mindent egybevetve' and end with 'a fentiek tükrében'.
c1-varosfejlesztes-05.target: Mindent egybevetve, a városkutatók véleménye megoszlik a 15 perces városról. A fentiek tükrében a vita folytatódik.
c1-varosfejlesztes-05.english: All things considered, the urban researchers' opinions are divided about the 15-minute city. In the light of the above the debate continues.
c1-varosfejlesztes-05.canDo: I can describe the idea of the 15-minute city and the debate about it (*15 perces város, részvételi költségvetés, emberléptékű terek*).

c1-varosfejlesztes-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The City Debate in Summary
c1-varosfejlesztes-consolidation.scenario: You close the seminar by summing up what was said about Budapest and its surroundings.
c1-varosfejlesztes-consolidation.prompt: Name one problem, say whose view it is, and end with a conclusion.
cues: Name a problem and whose view it is
c1-varosfejlesztes-consolidation.target: Egyes városkutatók szerint az ingázók nagy száma terhelést jelent a bevezető utakra. A fentiek tükrében a vita a városfejlesztésről még folytatódik.
c1-varosfejlesztes-consolidation.english: According to some urban researchers the large number of commuters is a burden on the approach roads. In the light of the above the debate about urban development continues.
c1-varosfejlesztes-consolidation.canDo: I can describe commuting, former industrial areas and transport in and around Budapest, naming whose view each is.

c1-visegrad-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Two Meetings at Visegrád
c1-visegrad-01.scenario: In a seminar on the Visegrád Group you are asked what happened at Visegrád in 1335 and in 1991.
c1-visegrad-01.prompt: Tell the seminar about the two meetings at Visegrád.
cues: Say what the three countries wanted
c1-visegrad-01.target: 1335-ben három király találkozott Visegrádon. 1991-ben Havel, Antall József és Wałęsa aláírta a Visegrádi Nyilatkozatot, mert a három ország közösen akart csatlakozni Európához.
c1-visegrad-01.english: In 1335 three kings met at Visegrád. In 1991 Havel, József Antall and Wałęsa signed the Visegrád Declaration because the three countries wanted to join Europe together.
c1-visegrad-01.canDo: I can describe the 1335 meeting at Visegrád and the 1991 Visegrád Declaration.

c1-visegrad-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Condition for a Pipeline
c1-visegrad-02.scenario: In a class on regional energy you present how a country can agree to a shared pipeline and still set a condition.
c1-visegrad-02.prompt: Say that you support a shared pipeline and name one condition.
c1-visegrad-02.target: Támogatjuk a közös vezetéket, azzal a megkötéssel, hogy nem veszélyezteti a hazai energiaellátást.
c1-visegrad-02.english: We support the shared pipeline, with the stipulation that it does not endanger the domestic energy supply.
c1-visegrad-02.canDo: I can describe the north-south energy and transport links of Central Europe.

c1-visegrad-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Positions on the War
c1-visegrad-03.scenario: In a class on the Visegrád Group you compare how two governments reacted to the war in Ukraine after 2022.
c1-visegrad-03.prompt: Contrast the Polish and the Hungarian position on weapons.
c1-visegrad-03.target: Míg Lengyelország fegyverrel is támogatta Ukrajnát, addig Magyarország nem szállított fegyvert.
c1-visegrad-03.english: While Poland supported Ukraine with weapons too, Hungary did not supply weapons.
c1-visegrad-03.canDo: I can describe how the Visegrád countries' positions on the war in Ukraine differed after 2022.

c1-visegrad-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Obligations in an EU Grant
c1-visegrad-04.scenario: In a class on EU funds you explain what a grant agreement obliges the beneficiary to do.
c1-visegrad-04.prompt: Explain one obligation of a beneficiary of EU funds.
c1-visegrad-04.target: A támogatási szerződés értelmében a kedvezményezett köteles elszámolni a felhasznált összeggel.
c1-visegrad-04.english: Under the grant agreement the beneficiary is obliged to account for the money used.
c1-visegrad-04.canDo: I can describe what EU cohesion funds and the Three Seas Initiative are for.

c1-visegrad-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bridge and the Ferry
c1-visegrad-05.scenario: In a class on Central Europe you explain an image used for the region.
c1-visegrad-05.prompt: Explain the image of the ferry country and whose it is.
cues: Say who is linked to it
c1-visegrad-05.target: Ady Endre nevéhez fűződik a kompország képe: egy ország, amely két part között ingázik.
c1-visegrad-05.english: The image of the ferry country is linked to Endre Ady: a country that shuttles between two shores.
c1-visegrad-05.canDo: I can explain the images of the bridge, the ferry country and the buffer state for Central Europe.

c1-visegrad-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Visegrád Group Review
c1-visegrad-consolidation.scenario: In a final class on the Visegrád Group you give a short summary of its history and its split over the war.
c1-visegrad-consolidation.prompt: Summarise two points about the Visegrád Group.
c1-visegrad-consolidation.target: 1991-ben három ország aláírta a Visegrádi Nyilatkozatot. Míg Lengyelország fegyverrel is támogatta Ukrajnát, addig Magyarország nem szállított fegyvert.
c1-visegrad-consolidation.english: In 1991 three countries signed the Visegrád Declaration. While Poland supported Ukraine with weapons too, Hungary did not supply weapons.
c1-visegrad-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the 1335 meeting and the 1991 Visegrád Declaration.

c1-vizgazdalkodas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dry Wells
c1-vizgazdalkodas-01.scenario: In a class on water management you report what has happened to the wells on the Sand Ridge.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-01.prompt: Say what has happened to the groundwater, with your judgement.
cues: Say it is the researchers' finding
c1-vizgazdalkodas-01.target: Sajnos a kutatók szerint süllyedt a talajvíz szintje a Homokhátságon.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-01.english: Unfortunately, according to the researchers, the groundwater level has fallen on the Sand Ridge.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-01.canDo: I can describe how the groundwater level has fallen on the Sand Ridge between the Danube and the Tisza.

c1-vizgazdalkodas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Duty to Protect Water
c1-vizgazdalkodas-02.scenario: In a class on rivers you report an expert's call for rules to protect the water.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-02.prompt: Say whose duty it is to protect water, according to some experts.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-02.target: Egyes szakértők szerint az államnak kötelessége megóvni a vízkészleteket.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-02.english: According to some experts the state has a duty to protect the water resources.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-02.canDo: I can describe how the Tisza was regulated and what followed.

c1-vizgazdalkodas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: More Water in the Landscape
c1-vizgazdalkodas-03.scenario: In a class on floodplains you link water retention to drought risk.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-03.prompt: Say how the amount of water kept in the landscape relates to drought risk.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-03.target: Minél több vizet tartunk meg a tájban, annál kisebb az aszály veszélye.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-03.english: The more water we keep in the landscape, the smaller the risk of drought.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-03.canDo: I can describe how floodplain farming and wetland restoration work.

c1-vizgazdalkodas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Careful Forecast
c1-vizgazdalkodas-04.scenario: In a class on industry and water you give a careful forecast.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-04.prompt: Give a hedged forecast about industrial water use and local wells.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-04.target: A bírálók szerint a nagy vízigényű üzemek minden valószínűség szerint csökkentik a helyi kutak vízszintjét.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-04.english: According to the critics, plants that use a lot of water will in all likelihood lower the level of local wells.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-04.canDo: I can describe the debate about industrial water use and the new battery plants.

c1-vizgazdalkodas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Negligible
c1-vizgazdalkodas-05.scenario: In a final class on water policy you say calmly that a problem is significant.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-05.prompt: Say that the damage caused by drought is significant, using an understatement.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-05.target: Az aszály miatti károk nem elhanyagolhatók a mezőgazdaságban.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-05.english: The damage caused by drought is not negligible in agriculture.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-05.canDo: I can describe what water sovereignty means and why experts discuss it.

c1-vizgazdalkodas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Water Review
c1-vizgazdalkodas-consolidation.scenario: In a final class on water management you summarise two points.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-consolidation.prompt: Summarise one problem and say how serious it is.
cues: Use a stance adverb or an understatement
Say it is the researchers' view
c1-vizgazdalkodas-consolidation.target: Sajnos a kutatók szerint süllyed a talajvíz szintje, és az aszály miatti károk nem elhanyagolhatók.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-consolidation.english: Unfortunately, according to the researchers, the groundwater level is falling, and the damage caused by drought is not negligible.
c1-vizgazdalkodas-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the drying Sand Ridge and the regulation of the Tisza.
